title: The Private Residential Tenancies (Prescribed Notices and Forms) (Scotland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under various powers conferred on the Scottish Ministers in the Private Housing (Tenancies) (Scotland) Act 2016 (“the Act”) to prescribe the requirements which must be fulfilled by certain notices given by a landlord under the Act; the contents, form and manner of service of such notices; the form of certain referrals by a tenant to a rent officer under the Act and the manner in which such a referral should be intimated to the landlord. The forms contained in these Regulations are for use by landlords and tenants on and after 1 April 2027.

title: The Access to the Countryside (Coastal Margin) (Kimmeridge Bay to Highcliffe) (No. 2) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints the day on which the access preparation period ends in relation to land which is coastal margin as a result of the approval, by the Secretary of State, of Natural England’s proposals contained in reports relating to coastal access upon the long-distance route between Kimmeridge Bay and Highcliffe. Copies of the notices of approval are available at www.gov.uk and may also be obtained by writing to the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, Seacole Building, 2 Marsham Street, London SW1 4DF.
